t.9014-01-1.agn: The raw material (enzyme powder) is a respiratory sensitiser when inhaled (H334), which is why detergents use it encapsulated or in liquid form. If the finished product has this hazard, the label states it. It must be declared as an enzyme on the detergent label.
t.9014-01-1.pw.0: An enzyme that can cause asthma-like symptoms when inhaled (H334); do not breathe in the dust of powder detergents.
t.9014-01-1.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 647-012-00-8 (CLP00): STOT SE 3, Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Dam. 1, Resp. Sens. 1.
t.9014-01-1.reg.det: Must be declared as an enzyme on the detergent label, whatever its concentration.
t.9014-01-1.summary: An enzyme obtained from bacteria that breaks down proteins.
t.9014-01-1.what: Breaks down protein stains such as blood, egg and milk at low temperatures.
t.tem.h.H334: H334 May cause allergy or asthma symptoms or breathing difficulties if inhaled.
